text:
First, using athena plan output and crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs, record how the improvement turn chooses among several ready Athena-own requests. If it takes them by queue age, rank them instead by the number of distinct jobs whose cause each one addresses (as hestia improvement_of counts them), then newest first. Make athena plan print the expected dispatch number of each Athena-own request. Do not change the one-in-three share. Acceptance: a test with 200 older ordinary items, 10 older Athena-own items and 6 newer Athena-own items whose causes recur in more jobs shows the 6 newer items take the first improvement turns. The plan output shows each item's expected dispatch number. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test pass. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Fixes the steward queued last night sit near the end of a 203-item plan, and the improvement turn reaches only a few older Athena items
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs, CHANGELOG.md
